scope: Index of published project records and reproducible entry points; not independent certification of AI authorship or a new test run.

attribution.basis: Maintainer production account, described in docs/PROVENANCE.md and docs/AI_DEVELOPMENT.md
attribution.identityLimit: Commit attribution identifies a contributor; it does not certify which lines or pixels were generated.

evidenceKinds.production-account: Reported workflow and provenance; original private transcripts or generation receipts are not included.
evidenceKinds.inspectable-change: Public fixed commit and current artifact; establishes implementation and file content.
evidenceKinds.recorded-measurement: Published result with stated environment and sample scope; not a new measurement.
evidenceKinds.reproduction-entry: Executable source or command; running it produces evidence for that run only.

entries.title: Generated components enter a real art and rigging workflow
entries.aiRoleReported: Firefly material generation; Codex task planning and tool orchestration
limits: No public original generation sessions, prompt/seed receipts or final pixel/layer mapping.
The retained PSDs are WIP and patch inputs, not complete final masters for all outfits.

entries.title: Editable Cubism source, runtime and viewer delivery
entries.aiRoleReported: Codex production task orchestration, software implementation and verification tooling

reproduce.establishes: Manifest identity and runtime reference closure, not rig quality or AI authorship

limits: Finite recorded model/visual coverage is defined in docs/VALIDATION.md.
Character assets use their own source-available license; SDK is obtained separately.

entries.title: Lossless web textures and recoverable loading
entries.aiRoleReported: Codex implementation, failure diagnosis, measurement and documentation

measurement.meaning: Eight original PNGs and lossless web copies with decoded RGBA equality; source record holds byte totals

reproduce.requires: Installed web dependencies, Playwright browser, separately obtained SDK and a running production preview; report directory must be new
reproduce.establishes: The loading/recovery scenarios reported by this real-browser run

limits: Recorded network timings are one before/after cold/warm pair on one machine, not field performance.
A passing final run does not erase the retained intermediate timeouts.

entries.title: Runnable controller, runtime, cleanup and DOM checks

reproduce.establishes: Controller intent, timing, runtime and resource contracts with explicit doubles

reproduce.requires: Installed dependencies and Playwright Chromium, or BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge with local Edge
reproduce.establishes: Public DOM listener behavior in a real browser without rendering a model

limits: SDK-free checks do not establish real Cubism rendering, visual quality or a generation percentage.

entries.title: Share the production and correction workflow
entries.aiRoleReported: Codex synthesis of production steps, failure recovery and portable validators
limits: Skill prose is CC BY 4.0 and utility scripts are MIT; the package does not include the character assets or Cubism SDK.
Using the Skill does not establish that another model has passed its stage gates.

entries.title: Responsive project page with actual-renderer fallback
entries.aiRoleReported: Codex frontend implementation, checks and contributor documentation

reproduce.requires: Installed dependencies, Playwright browser, separately obtained SDK and running production preview; report directory must be new
reproduce.establishes: Named responsive, keyboard, reduced-motion and load-recovery scenarios

limits: The poster and cover are captures of actual rendering, not newly generated promotional artwork.
The published page-check scope is finite and does not establish universal device coverage.
